```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, ".."))
using AIHydroPoints
using DataFrames
using PrettyTables
```

## Surge Leaderboard

```{julia}
#| echo: false
settings = Dict(
    "root_dirs"  => joinpath(@__DIR__, "training_output"),
    "quantities" => ["surge"],
    "sort_by"    => "rmse_testing",
    "ascending"  => true,
)

lb = load_leaderboard(settings["root_dirs"]; quantities=settings["quantities"])

if isempty(lb)
    @warn "No runs found."
else
    lb = sort_leaderboard(lb, settings["sort_by"]; ascending=settings["ascending"])
    lb[!, :rank] = 1:nrow(lb)
    select!(lb, :rank, :)
end

display_cols = [:rank, :runid, :model_name, :out_quantities, :rmse_testing,
                :n_params, :train_time_s]
available = [c for c in display_cols if c in propertynames(lb)]
pretty_table(lb[!, available]; backend=:html, stand_alone=false, column_labels=string.(available))
```
